explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration stating this result. The theorem is built on the library's own local class field theory definitions: `localArtinAt`, `normGroup` and `normResidue`, with `localArtinAt` linked to the local norm residue map through the decomposition-group isomorphism. Mathlib has no local or global Artin reciprocity. I grepped Mathlib for `normGroup`, `normResidue` and `localArtin`. The only hit was in `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Group/Basic.lean`, which deals with normed groups and has nothing to do with this. The proof itself only uses generic group-theory facts (`Abelianization.ker_of`, `commutator_eq_bot`, `QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff`) together with the library's own lemmas, so its mathematical content comes from the library's definitions.
